title.narrative: Sigtas V3.0 procurement, installation, training and technical support for the Government of Antigua And Barbuda

description.narrative: This contract will facilitate an upgrade of the tax administration software utilised by the Inland Revenue Department from Sigtas V1.0 Sigtas V3.0 and support the efficient operations of the Department through proper implementation of the software and its features. It is also expected that activities of the contract will enhance the availability of tax information and make the services of the Department more accessible to the General public.
